Seat 2's post is #19287 (🟢 os-elon-musk, `session_01VqGhCg9wdsBXPz54uAEWg7`, live on batch 3 since 2026-10-15T11:27Z).

## Current PM

⏳ **vacant** — released by `session_01GjUZrCo7Yi58T4vPXqx88e` (os-sales; seated on the maintainer's `/pm-dispatch skills`, round-open marker 6189611747) on the maintainer's 「当前任务处理完,合并后就下班」. The release marker is this seat's 收班简报, the newest comment on this post; a successor reads this body and seats at once with `/pm-dispatch skills`. Handover ledger: predecessor session `session_01GjUZrCo7Yi58T4vPXqx88e`; Routine `trig_01HAz8yqctKiTw7Z1MivNFKR` deleted at sign-off; no `send_later`; no live `subscribe_pr_activity` (every watch ended at its merge); every dev ran `mode:subagent` (nothing to archive; each worktree removed by its dev); the shared checkout is at `main` `5a3315490` and its mirror branch `claude/funny-mccarthy-fis2fz` is pushed; `check-harness-current` CURRENT. Seat 2 (#19287) is live and holds #23615; the lane's objectui board read 0 open `domain:skills` cards this shift.

## Inherited + running ledger

- **Landed this shift 3 (batch 1 on the maintainer's 「并发保持1」, every PR Tier S, reviewed in seat at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`):** #23578 — PR #23655 MERGED 2026-10-15T11:08Z as `1ced0f82b` (contract review 6190236120, `## 席位核对` 6190376540, pointer 6190385327, landing 6190657200): the at-tier review of a mixed diff is scoped to `reviewFace`'s `hits` plus the files those hunks claim about; `record-recognisers.mjs --template --paths PATH...` prints the `Scope:` floor. · #23579 — PR #23660 MERGED 2026-10-15T11:35Z as `881eeff31` (6190695761, 6190869174, pointer 6190881037, landing 6191141128): two rule lines in `execution-duties.md` (a split-off off-lane card does not inherit the parent's domain), its ceiling 183 → 185 by the measured delta under ruling B. · #23606 — PR #23668 MERGED 2026-10-15T12:24Z as `5a3315490` (6191503551, 6191600702, pointer 6191611362, landing 6192025579): the ratchet's header and four refusal strings name the ruled raise form, `SKILL.md`'s guard-index row reworded at 319/319. Every card closed by `Fixes`, `pm:dispatched` removed, the probe-table landing comment on each; closed-since scans clean.
- **Queue (`pm:queue` ∩ `domain:skills`) at sign-off: 0.** #23607 (p2, ruled A/A 6184828752: a package's `test:repo` is CI's run, in `os-dev.md`'s 本地验证范围 section; the build-heavy test for `mode:cloud` on `execution-duties.md`'s `mode:cloud` line, now L144 after PR #23660) — taken by seat 2 (`pm:dispatched`, os-elon-musk) once PR #23660's merge released the `execution-duties.md` chain; notes for that seat: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is mandated by the `os-dev.md` path; both files sit at their ceilings (`os-dev.md` 400/402, `execution-duties.md` 185/185) and each line it adds moves its `CEILINGS` row by the measured delta under ruling B 6184799323 (quote both ids and the delta in the PR body); the 120 B per-line cap may make one sentence two lines, as it did for #23579.
- **`pm:blocked` 1:** #23665 (p2, `tooling`, filed by the director seat 2026-10-15T11:24Z; `Blocked-by: #23653`, which is open and `pm:dispatched` under the `domain:devx` seat at sign-off): one line in `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` after #23653 lands — a PR that renames or removes an exported symbol runs the scoped platform-checklist check before push. It shares `os-dev.md` with #23607: serial, #23607 first unless #23653 closes first.
- **In flight 0 · Landing window 0 · Held 0 · Awaiting a human word 0** at sign-off. Seat 2's cards — #23615 (Tier H, `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`), #23607 (see above) and #23662 (p3 `bug`, filed and taken this hour) — are that seat's.
- **Decision box 0.** `pm:awaiting-maintainer` 0 · `pm:on-hold` 0 · `pm:retriage` 0 · bare `finding` 0 · `tracking` 2 (#22060, #17161).
- **Cross-lane watch (not this lane's cards):** PR #23486 (#23470, `domain:devx`) on `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` — receipted r215, no objection. PR #23596 (#23534, devx) moved the ratchet's `AGENTS.md` row to 1117 — receipted r216. #22085 (devx) owns `.github/workflows/release.yml`.

## Notes

- Job description and write paths: `references/lanes/skills.md`; content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` / `label-write.mjs` / `issue-create.mjs` / `close-cards.mjs` and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` (`issue_patch` for this post's title and PR bodies); route `dispatch` (relay); ⛔ no MCP write.
- Readings at sign-off: `check-harness-current.mjs` CURRENT at `5a3315490`; four-axis block `SKILL.md` lines 241–261, md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0`, unchanged by PR #23668 (`check:skill-frame-sync` green on its head). Platform readings this shift: the shared checkout's `node_modules` lags `pnpm-lock.yaml` after a fast-forward — `check-expected-skips.mjs` died on a missing `yaml` package until `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline` (9 s on the warm store); run it after any fast-forward that moves the lockfile. The relay's `pr_ready` then `automerge_enable` strokes enqueued each PR without a re-arm (70 s, 50 s and 150 s after the arm; `mergeable_state` read `blocked` after each flip). A squash merge leaves the PR head a non-ancestor of `main`: the MERGED readings are the queue ref gone, a control commit's ancestry, and the merge commit's touch on the governed file. `check-expected-skips.mjs --pr N` exits 3 while a shard is `in_progress` — a reading of no reading, not a verdict. Seat 2's label write on an already-claimed card added a second assignee for a minute (rolled back, yield note 6190910496): the pre-write re-read must gate on the assignee and the newest `Claim:`. A dev's mis-backgrounded `nohup` left a 19-byte `/battery2.pid` at this container's filesystem root (the harness refused its `rm`; container-local, outside the repository; dies with the container). r215's Notes (the arming budget, `post-stamped` refusals, the queue's group stacking, the organisation-side 403, the queue-ref listing) stand in the edit history.
- Timers and subscriptions at sign-off: Routine `trig_01HAz8yqctKiTw7Z1MivNFKR` deleted; no `send_later`; `subscribe_pr_activity` live on none.
